description: This file implements functions for merging notes in a Git repository, including diffing, conflict resolution, and commit creation for notes merge operations.

methods.name: init_notes_merge_options
methods.description: Initializes notes merge options with default values and repository reference.

methods.name: path_to_oid
methods.description: Converts a file path to an object ID by parsing the hex string.

methods.name: verify_notes_filepair
methods.description: Verifies the status of a diff filepair and extracts the object ID.

methods.name: find_notes_merge_pair_pos
methods.description: Finds or inserts a notes_merge_pair in a sorted list based on object ID.

methods.name: diff_tree_remote
methods.description: Computes the diff between base and remote commits for notes merging.

methods.name: diff_tree_local
methods.description: Computes the diff between base and local commits for notes merging.

methods.name: check_notes_merge_worktree
methods.description: Ensures the notes merge worktree exists and is properly set up.

methods.name: write_buf_to_worktree
methods.description: Writes a buffer to a file in the notes merge worktree.

methods.name: write_note_to_worktree
methods.description: Reads a note object and writes it to the worktree.

methods.name: ll_merge_in_worktree
methods.description: Performs a low-level merge of note blobs and writes the result to the worktree.

methods.name: merge_one_change_manual
methods.description: Handles manual conflict resolution for a single note change.

methods.name: merge_one_change
methods.description: Merges a single note change according to the specified strategy.

methods.name: merge_changes
methods.description: Merges multiple note changes, handling conflicts.

methods.name: merge_from_diffs
methods.description: Performs a merge of notes from base, local, and remote commits.

methods.name: notes_merge
methods.description: Main function to perform notes merging between local and remote refs, producing a merged result.

methods.name: notes_merge_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with the merged notes from the worktree.

methods.name: notes_merge_abort
methods.description: Aborts the notes merge by cleaning up the worktree.
